Enum Class ParserState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ParserState>
it.polimi.ingsw.view.ParserState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ParserState>, Constable
public enum ParserState extends Enum<ParserState>
Enumeration representing the different possible states of the parser during the game. Each state corresponds to a specific point in the game where user input or specific actions are required by the system.
